# Solidity Benchmarks

These values are generated from deterministic Foundry tests and checked into the repository so benchmark changes are visible in GitHub diffs. Gas matches transaction receipt `gasUsed`: the post-refund total includes intrinsic gas, calldata, proxy routing, and execution.

The benchmark profile uses Solidity 0.8.37, the Cancun EVM, IR compilation, 10,000 optimizer runs, and the fixtures committed under `test/`.

Regenerate the JSON snapshots and this document from the repository root:

```sh
just solidity::benchmark-update
```

## SP1 Tendermint end-to-end packet benchmarks

Each measurement runs as an isolated transaction. Relay operations include the complete router multicall, SP1 proof verification, packet handling, and application callbacks. The ERC20 send assumes the token allowance is already set.

The send value is the average of 50 separate transactions, including the more expensive first transfer that deploys the escrow contract.

### Packet operations

| Operation | Groth16 gas | Plonk gas | Groth16 calldata | Plonk calldata |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Send ERC20 (50-transaction average) | 164,852 | 164,852 | 516 | 516 |
| Acknowledge ERC20 end-to-end | 444,271 | 511,429 | 3,748 | 4,356 |
| Receive returning ERC20 end-to-end | 551,236 | 618,426 | 3,652 | 4,260 |
| Receive new Cosmos token end-to-end | 1,124,080 | 1,191,054 | 3,652 | 4,260 |
| Timeout ERC20 end-to-end | 501,682 | 569,033 | 3,652 | 4,260 |

## Linea light-client scaling benchmarks

These isolated transactions use beacon blocks and proofs produced in-process by the `MaruSimSuite` chain simulator in `test/linea/utils`.

A client update carries the whole beacon block body, so its cost grows with the transactions of the block. The blocks below are sealed by one validator and carry the given number of non-zero transaction bytes. The benchmark EVM is Cancun, which charges 16 gas per non-zero calldata byte. A chain with EIP-7623 charges a transaction at least 40 gas per non-zero calldata byte, which is more than these totals for the larger blocks.

| Transaction bytes | Client update gas | ABI calldata bytes |
| ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 112,034 | 1,540 |
| 1,024 | 129,371 | 2,564 |
| 16,384 | 381,653 | 17,924 |
| 131,072 | 2,293,885 | 132,612 |
| 1,048,576 | 19,397,405 | 1,050,116 |

Linea runs one validator. The blocks below have no transactions and are sealed by every validator of a larger set.
